---
name: Video Style / Channel Request
about: Suggest a new video format, channel aesthetic, or voice profile
title: '[STYLE REQUEST] '
labels: enhancement, aesthetic
assignees: ''
---

**Channel / Content Style Proposal**
Describe the video style, target niche, or reference YouTube channel (e.g., `@GHIBLISTYLESTUDIO`, `@AuralyEditsYT`).

**Visual Aesthetic**
- Resolution & Aspect Ratio: [e.g., 9:16 vertical Shorts, 16:9 landscape]
- Visual Generator / Prompts: [e.g., Flux watercolor Ghibli, Minecraft gameplay, split-screen comparison]

**Audio & Voiceover Atmosphere**
- Narration language & voice: [e.g., Hindi SwaraNeural, English GuyNeural]
- Background soundscape: [e.g., ASMR rain on tin roof, lo-fi piano, dramatic phonk]

**Target Audience & Pacing**
Who is this video for, and how fast should scenes transition?
